import json,hashlib,sys
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone
import numpy as np
repo=Path.cwd();root=repo/"learnings/policy_tuning/RobotLab-Isaac-Velocity-Flat-LW-wheel-Roa-v0/2026-10-03_22-59-50"
def ref(p):return {"path":str(Path(p).resolve()),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
def write(p,v):
 with Path(p).open("x",encoding="utf-8") as f:json.dump(v,f,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False);f.write("\n")
prepath=root/"evidence/source/checkpoint-sweep-preflight-20261008-001.json";pre=json.loads(prepath.read_text())
out=root/"evidence/analysis/checkpoint-sweep-static-comparison-20261008-001";out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
source=root/"evidence/source/checkpoint-sweep-static-aggregation-20261008-001.json"
write(source,{"version":1,"python":_controller_source,"sha256":hashlib.sha256(_controller_source.encode()).hexdigest(),"preflight":ref(prepath),"no_model_inference":True})
allmodels={};refs=[];total=0
for k in (30000,35000,40000,45000,49999):
 p=Path(pre["reused_final_static"]["path"]) if k==49999 else root/"evidence/analysis"/f"static-rightturn-model{k}-20261008-001/metrics.json"
 d=json.loads(p.read_text());assert d["checkpoint"]==next(x["checkpoint"] for x in pre["checkpoints"] if x["iteration"]==k)
 assert d["verification"]["weights_rng_and_gradient_buffers_unchanged"]
 assert d["verification"]["source_and_dirty_worktree_unchanged"]
 for r in d["artifacts"].values():assert ref(r["path"])==r
 assert d["historical_policy_inference_count"]==0
 allmodels[str(k)]=next(iter(d["models"].values()));refs.append(ref(p))
 if k!=49999:total+=d["method"]["finite_budget"]["actual_model_input_vectors"]
assert total==197960
import matplotlib;matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(10,7),constrained_layout=True)
for ax,kind in zip(axes,("q","dq")):
 for shift,stage in ((-.18,"onset_left"),(.18,"growth")):
  ax.bar(np.arange(len(allmodels))+shift,[m["windows"][stage]["sensitivity"]["full_current_"+kind]["spectral_norm_median"] for m in allmodels.values()],.36,label=stage)
 ax.set_xticks(range(len(allmodels)),list(allmodels));ax.set_ylabel("Gq rad/rad" if kind=="q" else "Gdq rad/(rad/s)");ax.legend()
fig.suptitle("2026-10-03 wheel-flat ROA | same recorded hardware inputs")
plot=out/"hip-sensitivity-by-checkpoint.png";fig.savefig(plot,dpi=150);plt.close(fig)
rows=[]
for k,m in allmodels.items():
 row={"checkpoint_iteration":int(k)}
 for stage in ("onset_left","growth","all_turn"):
  for kind in ("q","dq"):row[stage+"_G"+kind]=m["windows"][stage]["sensitivity"]["full_current_"+kind]["spectral_norm_median"]
  row[stage+"_target_step_rms_rad"]=m["windows"][stage]["outputs"]["baseline"]["hip_target_first_difference_rms_rad"]
 rows.append(row)
write(out/"metrics.json",{"version":1,"created_at":datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),"models_by_checkpoint":allmodels,"summary_rows":rows,
"new_metrics":refs[:-1],"reused_final_metrics":refs[-1],"analysis_source":ref(source),"preflight":ref(prepath),"historical_policy_inference_count":0,"total_new_input_vectors":total,
"method":d["method"],"artifacts":{"plot":ref(plot)},"limitations":d["limitations"],"policy_description_required":pre["policy_description_required"]})
print(json.dumps({"static_comparison":ref(out/"metrics.json"),"rows":rows},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
